target_audience.primary_persona: Marketing agencies and social media managers in Belgium and Europe who manage multiple clients and need cross-platform analytics
secondary_personas: Small business owners managing their own social media presence
Content creators tracking performance across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook
Freelance social media consultants with multiple clients
pain_points: Fragmented analytics across multiple social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, etc.)
Information overload from complex enterprise tools
Difficulty tracking same content performance across different platforms
TikTok API limitations making analytics difficult
Privacy concerns with traditional analytics tools like Google Analytics
High cost of enterprise social media tools (Hootsuite, Sprout Social)
No easy way to correlate website visits with social media performance
Manual effort to export and combine data from multiple platforms
goals: Track unified analytics across all social media platforms in one dashboard
Compare performance of same content across different platforms
Plan and optimize content with AI-powered hashtag suggestions
Identify best times to post based on historical performance
Generate client reports without information overload
Maintain privacy compliance (GDPR) while collecting analytics
target_audience.usage_context: Daily/weekly dashboard checks by marketing professionals, typically accessed via desktop browser during work hours, with mobile access for quick performance checks

product_vision.one_liner: Privacy-focused social media analytics SaaS platform with unique cross-platform content tracking and smart filtering to prevent data overwhelm
product_vision.problem_statement: Marketing agencies and social media managers struggle to track performance across multiple platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube), facing fragmented data, high tool costs, and information overload. There's no easy way to see how the same piece of content performs across different platforms.
product_vision.value_proposition: SocialBit offers affordable, privacy-focused analytics with a unique cross-platform content correlation feature that lets you track 1 TikTok = 1 Instagram post, smart filtering to prevent overwhelm, AI-powered hashtag optimization, and self-hosted data ownership on Plesk infrastructure.
success_metrics: Number of active paying clients (target: 3-7 to break even)

existing_features: Basic vanilla PHP router with pattern matching
TikTok CSV importer for analytics data
Basic controller structure (Auth, Posts, Analytics, Planning, Settings, Import, Labels)
Repository pattern for data access (Post, Planning, Settings, TikTok, User, Analytics)
known_gaps: No functional dashboard UI (currently just HTML skeleton)
Instagram Graph API integration not implemented
No queue system for background jobs
technical_debt: Database credentials hardcoded in config file instead of environment variables
TikTok API secrets visible in plain text in config
No test suite or testing infrastructure
Documentation exists but code implementation is minimal
Planning documents extensive but actual code is skeleton only

alternatives: Metricool (9-449 EUR/mo) - Mature, cross-platform scheduling + analytics
Buffer (6-120 USD/mo) - Easy to use, great scheduling, limited cross-platform comparison
Hootsuite (99-739 USD/mo) - Enterprise features, team collaboration, expensive and complex
Sprout Social (249-499 USD/mo) - Advanced analytics, social listening, very expensive
differentiators: Cross-platform content correlation (unique: track same content across platforms)
Affordable pricing for small businesses (29-199 EUR/mo target)
Privacy-focused analytics using Fathom as alternative to GA4
Smart filtering to prevent information overload
Content planning with AI-powered hashtag suggestions
Self-hosted option for complete data ownership
competitive_context.market_position: Mid-market affordable alternative to enterprise tools, positioned for European marketing agencies and small businesses who need powerful cross-platform analytics without the complexity and high cost of Hootsuite or Sprout Social

technical: Must run on Plesk Obsidian hosting infrastructure
TikTok API access is limited - may need Phyllo ($99-499/mo) or CSV workarounds
Social media API rate limits require smart polling and queue systems
OAuth token management and refresh handling required
Time-series data storage can grow large quickly - needs retention policies
resources: Solo developer project (inferred from git history - 2 commits, single author)
Self-funded development timeline of 3-4 months for MVP
Monthly operational budget estimate: 150-650 EUR depending on third-party services
Learning curve: OAuth 2.0, API integrations, data visualization, multi-tenancy
dependencies: Meta Graph API for Instagram/Facebook (free, requires Facebook Developer account)
TikTok Developer API or Phyllo service for TikTok analytics
Fathom Analytics API for privacy-focused website tracking ($15+/mo)
Google Analytics 4 Data API for comprehensive website data
RiteKit or Ayrshare API for hashtag suggestions ($29-99/mo)
Redis for caching and job queues
